tasks.short: Advise managers on employees’ qualifications for roles, grades, or development opportunities.

steps.what: Clarify the employee, proposed role, and qualification question with the requesting manager.
Retrieve employment history, recorded qualifications, and completed training from the {HCM} and {LMS}.
Read certificates and experience documents, checking missing or outdated qualification evidence.

loop.input: Authorised qualification evidence and the fields required by the assessment scope.
loop.output: Credential facts with document references, dates, and unresolved fields.
loop.check: Require a source location for each fact; validate dates and identifiers. A specialist checks disputed credentials.
loop.stop: One extraction and one correction pass per document. Unreadable, conflicting, or unsupported facts enter an exception queue.
loop.why_not_simpler: Legacy certificates and experience statements contain relevant facts outside consistent fields. Structured records bypass the loop.

steps.what: Compare checked evidence against documented role requirements in a {SPREADSHEET} matrix.
Judge qualification equivalence, experience relevance, and limits of the available evidence.
Discuss qualification advice, uncertainties, and development options with the requesting manager.
Record the advice and supporting evidence references in the {HCM}.

tasks.design: A request form in the {WORKFLOW} retrieves authorised records from the {HCM}, {LMS}, and {DOCS}, then builds a factual requirements matrix using explicit rules. A bounded extraction loop handles unstructured evidence, with a specialist approving extracted facts and interpreting equivalence. After the human discussion, an approved advice record returns to the {HCM}; the matrix does not make appointment or pay decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence was scattered, credential names varied, and integrations cost more than this supplemental task justified. Advice also depended on context that qualification fields did not capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing forms and connectors can handle intake and retrieval. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of building the comparison rules, while bounded extraction can handle document variation.
tasks.still_hard: Foreign credential equivalence, incomplete experience records, and disputed role requirements need expertise. GDPR applies to employee records; national rules govern consultation, and any future AI worker evaluation needs an EU AI Act scope assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why evidence matters, recognise relevant experience beyond formal credentials, and challenge requirements that unfairly exclude people.

ambition.what: Qualification gap consultations for employees exploring an internal move before applying.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends less time finding certificates and more time discussing equivalence and development routes. They gain no appointment or pay authority; those decisions remain with the authorised manager.

reach.task: Turn evidenced qualification gaps into suitable learning pathways.
reach.learn: Course prerequisites, recognised credentials, and how completion demonstrates the missing capability.
How role requirements are set and how employees can correct inaccurate qualification records.

evidence.claim: Record retrieval and explicit qualification comparisons can use integrations and deterministic rules; suitability advice still requires judgement.
Document extraction can produce referenced qualification facts for review, but this digest contains no direct implementation case.
Significant solely automated employee decisions require assessment against GDPR Article 22.
AI worker evaluation may fall within the EU AI Act employment high-risk category.
Dutch works council consent rules include certain employee-data and monitoring arrangements; other countries have national rules.

assumptions: The task concerns internal qualification advice in a mid-size European employer, rather than professional licensing decisions.
Role requirements exist, but the specialist must interpret some experience and credential equivalence.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates, not measured results.
Consultation and access ranges describe working effort; elapsed approval time may be longer.
unknowns: Which qualification facts are reliably maintained in the {HCM} and {LMS}.
Whether the {HCM} supports restricted advice records and approved writes.
Who can access certificates, experience statements, and advice records.
Which credential equivalence rules and collective agreements apply.
Which national consultation requirements apply to the proposed change.
research_questions: Can explicit requirements cover factual comparisons without producing an employee ranking?
How often do documents introduce facts absent from structured records?
Which evidence checks require an external credential authority?
new_work: Review extracted facts and resolve conflicting evidence.
Maintain qualification mappings and versioned role requirements.
Handle employee corrections and access requests.
Monitor failed integrations, permissions, and retention rules.

tasks.short: Prepare compensation, benefits, or job analysis research for publication as reports, manuals, or learning material.

steps.what: Agree the audience, research question, publication format, and intended use.
Assemble research notes, approved data extracts, methods, and source documents from the {DOCS}.
Recalculate summary statistics and prepare publication tables and charts in the {SPREADSHEET}.
Interpret findings, challenge comparisons, and state methodological limits.
Write and format the manuscript, manual, or film script with citations and visual material.

loop.input: Approved findings outline, source documents, fixed tables and charts, and the publication brief.
loop.output: A formatted draft with claim-level source references and explicit limitations.
loop.check: Resolve every citation against the research pack. Compare all numerical claims with fixed results; flag unsupported claims for deletion or review.
loop.stop: One draft and at most two correction passes within a 15000-token budget. Unresolved claims remain flagged and block release.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates can place tables and headings, but varied audiences and research findings require new explanatory prose.

steps.what: Review substantive claims, confidentiality, and publication rights; approve the exact release version.
Publish the approved material through the {CMS} and archive the released version.

tasks.design: A controlled research pack in the {DOCS} feeds reproducible calculations and chart generation on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded drafting loop uses approved findings and traceable sources, while deterministic checks reconcile numbers and citations. The {WORKFLOW} captures approval of the exact release version before the {CMS} publishes it and the {DOCS} archives it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research publications were infrequent and varied in format, so bespoke automation was hard to justify. Manual copying connected calculations, prose, citations, and release approvals.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable calculation and publishing templates are cheaper to build with AI-assisted coding. Bounded drafting can adapt approved findings to an audience, while deterministic checks protect numerical consistency.
tasks.still_hard: Sound methods, defensible interpretation, disclosure risk, and editorial quality remain expert work. Small employee groups can remain identifiable after names are removed, and third-party research may restrict publication.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a useful question, distinguish evidence from speculation, and explain compensation findings without overstating fairness or causation.

ambition.what: An employee guide explaining job evaluation methods and their limitations.

tasks.altitude: During publication projects, the specialist spends less time copying figures and formatting drafts, and more time testing interpretations with readers. They can propose new publication formats; release authority remains with the authorised approver.

reach.task: Translate research findings into reward policy options.
reach.learn: How evidence quality, budget constraints, and employee effects shape a policy recommendation.

reach.task: Turn a research publication into employee learning material.
reach.learn: Learning objectives, accessible explanations, and checks that readers understand the method.

evidence.claim: Fixed analysis specifications support deterministic tables, charts, and reconciliation checks.
Approved sources and bounded drafting can reduce preparation work, but the digest contains no direct compensation-publication case.
A documented Australian government report case involved nonexistent sources and a partial refund, supporting direct citation verification.
Publication using employee research requires attention to GDPR purpose, access, and disclosure controls.

assumptions: This is an occasional supplemental task; reports and manuals are more typical than books or films.
The workflow ends with an approved release; a publisher submission can replace the {CMS} step.
The research dataset and analysis specification already exist. Designing and conducting a new study is separate work.
Film work here covers research content and script preparation, rather than full audiovisual production.
Time shares and build ranges are planning estimates. Low frequency may favour configuring templates before building integrations.
Consultation effort applies if employee-data use changes; access and rights checks apply to every implementation.
unknowns: The actual publication frequency, audience, formats, and release channels.
Whether existing analysis can be reproduced from retained source data.
Who approves scientific claims, employee-data disclosure, and external release.
Which source licences permit quotation, charts, or redistribution.
Whether the proposed data use requires employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which publication formats recur enough to justify reusable templates?
Which calculations and claim checks can run from a fixed analysis specification?
What disclosure thresholds are appropriate for the employee groups being described?
Would a manual template deliver sufficient value before adding a drafting loop?
new_work: Check generated prose against evidence and approved interpretations.
Maintain analysis specifications, templates, and citation checks.
Review disclosure risks and source publication rights.
Maintain release approvals, version archives, and correction procedures.

role.altitude: The specialist shifts from assembling evidence and formatting outputs toward interpreting qualifications and explaining research. They gain capacity for employee guidance and clearer publications, while appointment, pay, and release authority remain explicitly assigned.
reach: Training and development: connect qualification gaps with credible learning pathways.
Human resources management: turn research into evidence-based reward policy options.
Human resources operations: improve the accuracy and correction of qualification records.
skills_to_grow: Translate role requirements into explicit, testable factual checks.
Evaluate credential equivalence and recognise uncertainty.
Use reproducible analysis and verify numerical claims.
Write accessible explanations with traceable sources.
Apply employee-data access, retention, and disclosure controls.
role.ambitious_version: Offer early qualification guidance for internal career moves and publish an employee guide to job evaluation, supported by reusable evidence packs and reproducible analysis.

job.title: Compensation, Benefits, and Job Analysis Specialists
